captions.text: With Voice mode on in Settings, Maya can talk to Cori instead of typing.
On ChatGPT, she holds Right Option and asks Cori a question.
Cori listens. The bars follow her voice, and her words show as she says them.
She lets go, and her words go to Cori as her line.
Cori answers in the chat and says his reply out loud. Stop, or any key, quiets him.
Pressed by mistake? Escape while she holds it cancels, and nothing is sent.
The speech models run in her browser. Her voice never leaves the computer.
